digest.component_or_area: janitor plan recovery and architectural decision derisking (RP-02 through RP-06)
propositions: Five recovered approved decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed derisking briefs that preserve hard-won architectural intent, resolve implementation-critical ambiguities, and map behavioral changes before becoming implementation stories.
RP-02 BindingStore must provide ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with fail-closed atomicity semantics, not general multi-file ACID.

RP-03 requires singular retry ownership with maximum 3 physical invocations per atomic logical operation, 15 seconds cumulative sleep, three-consecutive scoped fuse for provider suspect outcomes, and fail-closed credential/configuration handling.

RP-04 operation-snapshot composition must enforce explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence, separate secret/provider boundary, non-secret subprocess envelope, and fail-closed malformed-config behavior.

RP-05 CLI registry must normalize canonical help for all 75 visible top-level commands via package data before handler loading, with aliases reusing canonical help and compatibility shims naming replacements.

RP-06 plan-review gate must honor effective applicability routing policy, retain only Option-B runtime failure handling (continue independent units, skip blocked units, preserve successes), require explicit non-empty applies_to for project LLM criteria, and enforce authored usd_budget > 0 without normalization.
